<function name="SetTabbingDisabled" parent="DTextEntry" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets whether or not the panel accepts <key>tab</key> key.
<note>Disabling tab key prevents the panel from unfocusing by mouse, however, still works for focusing to other keyboard focus.</note></description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="enabled" type="boolean">Whether the <page>DTextEntry</page> should ignore <key>tab</key>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
